cdk_facts_confirmed.dynamodb_tables: TpotBookingTable (pk bookingId, GSI instanceType-status-index), TpotNotificationConfigTable (pk configId), TpotDeploymentPlanTable (pk planId)
cdk_facts_confirmed.s3: compose bucket tpot-booking-compose-<account>-<region> (synced from lambda/deployer/compose-files); frontend bucket tpot-booking-frontend-<account>-<region> (uploads frontend/dist)
cdk_facts_confirmed.cloudfront: distribution serves SPA; /api/* behavior with CloudFront Function rewrites /api -> /<stage> to API Gateway; frontend calls relative /api/* (no build-time API URL needed)
cdk_facts_confirmed.api: TpotBookingApi REST; all methods use TokenAuthorizer Basic Auth from SSM SecureString /tpot-booking/basic-auth-credentials (format username:password). Routes: /bookings GET/POST, /bookings/{bookingId} GET/PUT/DELETE, /notifications GET/POST/PUT, /notifications/test-webhook POST, /status GET, /deployment-plans GET/POST, /deployment-plans/{planId} DELETE
cdk_facts_confirmed.lambdas: python3.12 handler.handler: tpot-booking-api-handler (30s), tpot-booking-deployer (10min, env MODEL_NAME default deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash overridable via context modelName), tpot-booking-capacity-poller (5min, env REGIONS=us-east-1,us-east-2,us-west-2 INSTANCE_PROFILE=tpot-bench-ec2-profile SECURITY_GROUP=tpot-bench-noingress-sg), tpot-booking-orphan-cleaner (5min, REGIONS same). Authorizer tpot-booking-authorizer inline.
cdk_facts_confirmed.eventbridge: poller every 1 min; deployer check_progress every 2 min; orphan-cleaner every 15 min
cdk_facts_confirmed.ec2_iam: stack CREATES IAM role tpot-bench-ec2-role + instance profile tpot-bench-ec2-profile (AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore + s3:GetObject on tpot-bench-scripts/*).
cdk_facts_confirmed.prerequisites_not_created_by_stack: SSM SecureString /tpot-booking/basic-auth-credentials (stack only fromSecureStringParameterAttributes references it); security group tpot-bench-noingress-sg and per-region subnets (poller only Describes them, never creates by name) - must be pre-provisioned. This matches the blog's 'subnet mapping' deploy step.
cdk_facts_confirmed.outputs: ApiUrl, CloudFrontDomain, BookingTableName, NotificationConfigTableName, DeploymentPlanTableName, NotificationTopicArn, FrontendBucketName, ComposeBucketName
cdk_facts_confirmed.frontend_build: cd platform/frontend && npm install && npm run build (tsc && vite build) -> produces frontend/dist which CDK BucketDeployment uploads
cdk_facts_confirmed.compose_plan_mapping_source: platform/docs/UPDATE-COMPOSE.md note 3 (filename<->plan id). 7 built-in yaml files present.
